text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Riga customs department head Vigo Leitholds has been sacked following irregularities discovered by the State Revenue Service. Prime Minister Andris Shkele demanded Leitholds' resignation on Monday.
- Israel's Communication's Minister Limora Livnate arrives in Latvia today and is due to sign a telecommunications agreement tomorrow.
- A parliamentary commission investigating the legality of a G-24 loan distribution will ask for its term to be prolonged.
- The 6th air-balooning festival, the Baltic Cup '97, started today in Sigulda with more than 30 baloons from 11 countries taking part.
